messages:
Talia: dropped two Figma variants for run-history tool-call previews: 'compact' (single-line signature + badge) and 'detailed' (two-line snippet + meta). figma: https://figma.redwood/preview-modes :eyes:
Evan: solid. main product question: which mode is default for new users? we should bias to compact for power users but make it discoverable for newcomers.
Ravi: propose a persistent toggle in the top-right of Run History: Compact / Detailed. persist per-user. also add a small 'Help (?)' that shows keyboard shortcuts.
Leah: accessibility note: the toggle must be keyboard operable and announce the current mode via aria-pressed or aria-checked. label it 'Preview mode: Compact' when active.
Talia: thinking about keyboard shortcuts: press K to expand/collapse focused card, Shift+C to copy signature, ? to open shortcuts overlay. objections?
Evan: like K but avoid conflicts with the editor. maybe use Enter to expand and K as optional accelerator. Shift+C seems fine for copy. please document in help overlay.
Ravi: SR flow: when a card is focused, screen reader should say 'Tool call, summarize, collapsed, 3 fields, examples available' then Tab or Enter to expand. keep utterances short.
Leah: copy micro-nit: header label should be 'summarize  23ms' or 'summarize  23ms'? prefer middle dot (·). also spell out 'no args provided' rather than 'no params' for clarity.
Talia: we've got two density asks from Ops: 44px rows vs Design 56px. propose adaptive rows: compact=44px, detailed=56px. also try a medium 48px for compact+long-names test.
Evan: good compromise. ensure focus ring thickness scales (3px for 44px rows, 4px for dense mode) and meets contrast.
Ravi: implementation note: collapsed mode should render only minimal DOM for perf (signature + badge), defer JSON parse until expansion. also lazy-load examples.
Leah: accessibility nit: 'Copy signature' must not be hover-only. include a focusable sr-only button visible on keyboard focus. When activated, announce 'Signature copied' via an assertive live region.
Talia: mock includes a compact JSON snippet for detailed mode:
```json
{"name":"summarize","params":{"text":"Very long doc...","length":"short"}}
```
Evan: UX decision: button label = 'View full output' (primary) and a smaller 'Copy signature' secondary. keep labels consistent across Playground and Run History.
Ravi: internationalization: make sure tool names and example content read correctly in SRs; avoid reading long content automatically. add a 'read full' action per field.
Leah: test plan: keyboard nav, screen reader reads (VoiceOver/NVDA), high-contrast themes, small-text scale, and mobile responsive layout for narrow screens. I'll draft tickets.
design-qa-bot: Uploaded Figma: https://figma.redwood/preview-modes (v1) — tests suggested: keyboard focus, SR flows, tooltip timing.
Talia: thanks all. I'll iterate on the Figma and land a prototype for dev to test next week. :rocket:
